package gen

import "context"

// ChargeRow is a charge: money is int64 minor units with its currency.
type ChargeRow struct {
	ID               string
	AmountMinor      int64
	DiscountMinor    *int64
	PlatformFeeBp    int64
	Currency         string
	PageTotal        int64 `json:"-"`
	RemainingMinor   int64
	UnusedFlag       bool
	SomeUnrelatedFee float64Holder
}

type float64Holder struct{}

// InsertCharge writes one charge.
func (q *Queries) InsertCharge(ctx context.Context, amountMinor int64, currency string) error {
	_, err := q.db.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO charges (amount_minor, currency) VALUES ($1, $2)`, amountMinor, currency)
	return err
}

// InsertCreditLedger calls a sibling wrapper of the same family.
func (q *Queries) InsertCreditLedgerTwice(ctx context.Context) error {
	return q.InsertCreditLedgerRow(ctx)
}
